title: Toggl Idle Time Share Above Twenty Percent
app: Obsidian Sync, Todoist, Toggl Track, Google Calendar / iCloud calendar exports, and task metadata ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=toggl:timeentry
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(eval(if(idle="true",duration_min,0))) as idle_min, sum(duration_min) as total_min by person _time
| eval idle_pct=round(100*idle_min/total_min,1)
| where total_min>0 AND idle_pct>20
| sort - idle_pct
description: Uses Toggl idle annotations telemetry to monitor how much logged time was classified as idle in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for weeks when focus time was fragmented by interruption, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Toggl idle annotations data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how much logged time was classified as idle so you can spot weeks when focus time was fragmented by interruption before it becomes annoying.
